title: The Kerala Irrigation and Water Conservation Act, 2003
full_text: The Kerala Irrigation and Water Conservation Act, 2003 2003-ലെ കേരള ജലസേചനവും ജലസംരക്ഷണവും ആക്റ്റ് Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 200331 Act Number: 31 Enactment Date: 2003-09-18 Act Year: 2003 Short Title: The Kerala Irrigation and Water Conservation Act, 2003 Hindi Title: 2003-ലെ കേരള ജലസേചനവും ജലസംരക്ഷണവും ആക്റ്റ് Long Title: An Act to consolidate and amend the laws relating to construction of irrigation works, conservation and distribution of water for the purpose of irrigation and levy of betterment contribution and irrigation cess on lands benefited by irrigation works in the State of Kerala and to provide for involvement of farmers in water utilisation systems and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
